'''Vroon''' was the [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] caretaker of the [[Sikadian Garden]]s. A follower of an ancient cult which worshiped [[drog]] beetles, he used his position to kill the garden's predatory [[shreev]]s in order to allow the drog population thrive. He was eventually killed by the insects.
